segments.description: Phase 2 Segment layout for Digquad controller — 15 segments covering all 711 LEDs with 3 door segments, combined AMS, individual tags, and background segments
changes_from_phase1: Expanded from 2 segments (skeleton) to 15 segments covering all 711 LEDs
Front Door split into 3 segments: Bottom (progress), Left (layer), Top (status)
AMS1 Top and Bottom combined into single segment (140 LEDs)
AMS2 Top and Bottom combined into single segment (139 LEDs)
8 individual tag top segments for per-tray highlighting (A1-A4, B1-B4)
Hygrometer and side-wall LEDs absorbed into adjacent tag/background segments
Interior Lid Light remains on MagWLED (separate controller, not part of DigQuad)

strips.name: Printer Front Door (C-Shape)
strips.description: C-shape LED strip on printer front: bottom (progress bar), left (layer/status), top (status indicator) — 3 separate segments

segments.name: Front Door Bottom
segments.purpose: Print progress bar — displays percentage complete
segments.effects: Solid, dynamic fill based on progress %

segments.name: Front Door Top
segments.purpose: Primary status indicator — always shows current state
segments.typical_colors: Blue (idle breathing), Orange (heating/prep), Green (printing), Red (error), Amber (offline), Purple (show)

strips.name: AMS 1 Lid/Spool Lighting (Combined)
strips.description: Reverse C-shape on AMS 1 lid — all top and bottom LEDs in single combined segment

segments.name: AMS1 Combined (Top + Bottom)
segments.purpose: Combined lighting for all AMS 1 tray tops, bottoms, and side walls
segments.typical_colors: Soft White (idle), White (printing), Orange (prep/maint), Yellow (paused), Red (error), Purple (show)

notes: Top sections, side wall, and bottom sections all combined into single segment
Cannot differentiate top vs bottom lighting within this segment
Use tag segments (5-8) to indicate which specific tray is active

strips.name: AMS 2 Lid/Spool Lighting (Combined)

notes: Top sections, side wall, and bottom sections all combined into single segment
Cannot differentiate top vs bottom lighting within this segment
Use tag segments (10-13) to indicate which specific tray is active

controller_notes.interior_lid_light: Controlled by MagWLED (separate controller). NOT part of the DigQuad segment layout.
controller_notes.magwled_presets: MagWLED has its own preset set ('Idle Standby', 'Normal Printing'). See apply_core_state_to_presets script.

implementation_notes: Each GPIO output's LEDs are fully covered by contiguous segments with no gaps
Tag segments include absorbed hygrometer and side-wall LEDs for Phase 2 simplicity
Phase 3 can use WLED API to individually address hygrometer LEDs within their segment
One spare segment slot (15) available for future use if needed
Segment boundaries are established by loading Preset 100 (SM Base Layout)
State presets 101-109 style existing segments without changing boundaries
reference_documents: See digquad-led-segments.md for detailed physical LED breakdowns
